tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ na mo bud+dha ya/ gang gi ye shes rdo rje'i me lce yis/ /bdag tu lta ba'i ri dang nags bcom ste/ /rnam shes bdun gnas sa 'og 'jig rten skyong*/ /lha yi lhar gyur rgyal ba'i dbang por 'dud/ /gang de'i bstan pa gnas skabs tha dad tshul/ /thams cad chos nyid 'di la 'bab tshul ston/ /'on kyang byis pa mi mthun rtsod gyur la/ /yang dag rigs pa'i gdams ngag sbyin par bya/ /gangs can 'di na mu stegs grub mtha' dang*/ /nyan thos tshul lugs gtso bor 'dzin pa med/ /de de'i bag chags sad rnams theg mchog gi /gzhung don log par 'grel 'di bzlog par bya/ /'phags yul mkhas rnams rgyal bas gsung phyin chad/ /lung de tshad ma nyid du khas len te/ /rigs pa nyes pa zad pa rdzun gyi tshig /mi gsung zhes 'dod de phyir nyan thos pa/ /theg chen rgyal ba'i bka' min zhes zer zhing*/ /bka' ru grub na de yang khas len pas/ /theg chen bka' sgrub bstan bcos rnams las mdzad/ /bod rnams rang 'dod dang mtshungs lung 'ga' zhig /'dod kyi gzhan kun thams cad drang don te/ /'gro la phan don yin pas ngo mtshar mod/ /ngo bo don la mi gnas rdzun du 'dod/ / 'di ltar 'dod la tshad ma'i lung mi 'grub/ /nyes pa kun zad rgyal ba rdzun gsung na/ /phyogs re spangs pa'i slob pa 'phags rnams dang*/ /nyes kun dang bcas so skye smos ci dgos/ /rdzun dang bcas pa skyes bu tshad ma min/ /don gyis sangs rgyas tshad ma min 'dod pa'i/ /nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba des ci rung*/ /zhes pa ni rgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma'i lung du bstan pa'o// //bod rnams phal cher 'khor lo rim gsum yang*/ /dang por chos kun bden grub bstan phyir rdzun/ /bar pa stong nyid bstan pas nges don te/ /phyi mar yod pa bstan phyir drang don lo/ /spyir ni drang don thams cad rdzun tshig min/ /gnas lugs mchog la 'dren pa'i lam stegs la/ /kun rdzob bden pa ston pa drang don dang*/

/don dam dngos po'i gnas lugs ston pa la/ /nges pa'i don du gsungs shing mkhas rnams 'dod/ /chos de gsungs pa'i dgos pa bstan pa kun/ /drang don yin par 'dod mod dam chos kun/ /gdul bya'i don phyir drang don nyid du 'gyur/ /klu sgrub dang ni thogs med sku mched kyis/ /'khor lo rnam gsum dgongs pa gcig tu bsgrubs/ /'khor lo dang por kun rdzob gsungs pa yang*/ /ji ltar snang ba de la de ltar gsungs/ /gnas lugs dpyad pa'i don la bden grub tu/ /bstan pa med pas de la rdzun tshig med/ /bar bar 'khor 'das chos kun bkag pa yang*/ /kun rdzob kun te bde gshegs snying po sogs/ /yod med gang yang ma gsungs dpyad pa med/ /de phyir de gnyis tha ma don mi 'gal/ /'on kyang dang por kun rdzob gtso bor bstan/ /bar du nges don phyed tsam tha mar ni/ /nges don don dam rdzogs par bstan pa yin/ /nad pa'i sman dang yi ge slob pa'i dpe'i/ /dgongs don 'di yin gzhan la 'gal ba yod/ /dang por chos kun tshugs thub yin no zhes/ /ston na ka t+ya ya na'i gdams ngag gi /mdo sde sogs dang nang 'gal yod par 'gyur/ /bar bar don dam dbyings sogs 'gog na ni/ /byams zhus sogs dang nang 'gal yod par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyi ston tshul la yang dpyad pa'o// //gzhan yang chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i le'ur ji skad du/ rab 'byor 'di ltar chos thams cad ni sprul pa ste/ de la la la ni nyan thos kyi sprul pa'o/ /la la ni rang sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'o/ /la la ni byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'o/ /la la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /la la ni nyon mongs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /la la ni chos kyi sprul pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na chos thams cad ni sprul pa lta bu yin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ gsol pa/ gang ma sprul pa'i chos de gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gang la skye ba med pa dang*/

'gag pa med pa de ni ma sprul pa'o/ /gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das de gang lags/ rab 'byor de ni mi bslu ba'i chos can mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ chos de ni ma sprul pa yin no/ /zhes mdo gsum du mthun par gsungs so/ /'dis ni bden gnyis yod mnyam dang med mnyam du 'dod pa bsal ba'o/ /'o na stong pa bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa ltar/ nges don mdo sde dag gi bye brag shes/ /gang las sems can gang zag skyes bur bstan/ /chos de thams cad drang ba'i don du shes/ /zhes pa 'di mi 'dod dam zhe na/ nges par 'dod do/ /'khor lo tha mar snying po bstan pa yang*/ /stong par ston gyi spros par mi 'chad la/ /dam pa'i bdag sogs gang zag tu mi ston/ /'di dang bstun na'ang tha ma mchog tu shes/ /dbang phyug sogs kyang 'phags par bshad mod kyi/ /ston par mi rung de tshig tshad mi bya/ /ci phyir zhe na dkon mchog las gzhan du/ /bstan phyir thar 'dod rnams kyis dor bya yin/ /'di na rgyal gsung tshad ma min pa dang*/ /slob dpon 'ga' zhig tshad mar 'dod pa yod/ /de dag mu stegs rnams dang blo gros mtshungs/ /'phags pa yin pas skyon de med snyam na/ /dbang phyug sogs la'ang rigs pa de mtshungs so/ /sangs rgyas las lhag 'dod phyir nang pa min/ /de tshig rgyal ba'i gsung las lhag pa'i phyir/ /skyes bu'ang de nyid mchog tu cis mi 'gyur/ /de dag rton pa bzhi yang log par smra/ /kun rdzob tu ni yod pas yod par 'dod/ /kun rdzob tu ni med na'ang med par 'dod/ /don dam du ni med kyang yod par 'dod/ /don dam mi rton kun rdzob la rton no/ /rnam shes ngo bor yod na yod par 'dod/ /rnam shes ngo bor med na med go gcod/ /ye shes snang ngor med kyang yod ces zer/ /ye shes spangs nas rnam shes tsam la ston/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos rnams phal cher rdzun/ /dgongs 'grel tshad ldan thams cad bden no lo/ /rtsa ba rdzun na dgongs 'brel bden mi srid/

/chos ni spong zhing gang zag rnams la rton/ / dgag pa gnyis kyi rnal mar go ba sogs/ /rtog ge ba bzhin tshig la rton pa'ang yod/ /rang stong smra ba phyis byung phal cher ni/ /rton pa bzhi las ring du byol ba yin/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las rton pa bzhi po bsngags// zhes pa ni drang nges las brtsams te rnam par dpyad pa'o// //skabs kyi don la slar yang brjod par bya/ /bar ba nges don phyi ma drang don du/ /ston byed mdo sde gsal po gang na'ang med/ /bar ba drang don phyi ma nges don du/ /dgongs pa nges 'grel myang 'das chen po dang*/ /sor 'phreng sogs kyi mdo las gsal bar bshad/ /lang kar gshegs par snying po drang don du/ /gsungs par 'dod pa ri bong cal dang mtshungs/ /mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs sam zhus pa la/ /stong nyid yin phyir mtshungs pa min zhes gsungs/ /stong nyid thams cad bden med med dgag la/ /'dod pa rang stong smra ba'i blo skyon yin/ /de bzhin nyid kyi stong nyid ye shes de/ /med dgag stong nyid bem stong kun rdzob bo/ kha cig phung po rnam dpyad stong nyid ni/ /chos kun med par 'dod pa yin no lo/ /de nyid rnam kun mchog ldan sgrub thabs su/ /de ma thag tu gsungs dang 'ga' bar 'gyur/ /rnam dpyad rigs pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid de/ /de nyid thabs su 'gyur la dgongs pa yin/ /'jug pa sogs su drang don du bkral yang*/ /rgyal bas nges pa'i don du bkral ba'i phyir/ /chos 'khor phyi ma nges pa'i don du grub/ /bar ba'i gleng gzhi dang por mthun pa mang*/ /tha ma'i gleng gzhi sngags dang mthun pa mang*/ de de'i phyir yang phyi ma mchog tu grub/ /drang don yin na zab par ga la 'gyur/ /khyad par :bar ba (《dzaṃ》 tha ma ) drang don yin gsungs pa'ang*/ /drang don yin na ha cang thal bar 'gyur/ /nges don mthar thug bstan pa'i rjes su yang*/ /gdul bya drang ba'i don la bkri ba ni/ /drang nges ston pa'i go rim shin tu 'khrugs/

/gang zag gcig la ston pa'i rim min na/ /bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung ba'i/ /rnam par dpyad pa 'thad ldan min par 'gyur/ /myang 'das gzung dbang gis zhus mdo la sogs/ /kun tu'ang gang zag bkri ba'i tshul la sbyar/ /'o ma'i sman gyi dpe dang nor bu'i dpe/ /gcig nyid sems kyi dri ma sbyong tshul lo/ /myang 'das chen por phyin ci log brgyad gsungs/ khyad par rgyal ba'i sku ni gtsang ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas zhing sogs bde dang don dam dbyings/ /rtag dang sems nyid dam pa'i bdag yin pas/ /sha khrag lus dang sdug bsngal bden pa dang*/ /skad cig cha bcas rang bzhin bden med du/ /rtog na log lta phyin ci log bzhir gsungs/ /'khor lo dang po 'jig rten pa dang mthun/ /bar bar kun rdzob rang bzhin med pa dang*/ /rgyal ba sras bcas yon tan bgrang yas sogs/ /mang pos nyan thos lugs las ches lhag mod/ /phal cher theg dman mdo dang mthun shas che/ /tha mar rang bzhin med tshul bar dang mtshungs/ / gzhan du nam yang yod par ma gsungs pa'i/ /khyad chos mang pos 'dir ni yod par bstan/ /chos lnga rang bzhin gsum dang rnam shes brgyad/ /theg chen thun mong min pa'i chos skad rnams/ /'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sder shin tu rgyas/ /bar bar mi gsal la lar bsdus te gsungs/ /dang po drang don tha ma'ang drang don can/ /yin na de gnyis mthun shas che dgos na/ /dang po tha ma ston tshul ches mi 'dra// zhes pa ni 'khor lo rim gsum gyi drang nges las brtsams te phyi ma mchog tu bsgrubs pa'o// //'khor lo rnam gsum dgongs pa'i gnad gcig kyang*/ /nyan thos rnams dang rang stong smra ba dang*/ /sems tsam pa dang gzhan stong smra ba rnams/ / 'dod tshul tha dad khyad par shin tu che/ /zhi 'tsho grol sde rjes 'brang bcas pa las/ /gzhan pa'i rang stong smra rnams kun rdzob ni/ /nyan thos sde gnyis po dang mthun par smra/ /sems tsam gzhan stong kun rdzob rnam gzhag mthun/

/rang stong smra ba nyan thos dang mthun la/ /gzhan stong smra ba sems tsam dang mthun mang*/ /de dag nyan thos pa dang sems tsam min/ /lang kar gshegs mdor sems tsam las 'das gsungs/ /sems tsam lta ba rnam shes bden grub yin/ /chos dbyings rnam shes min phyir 'di mi mtshungs/ /mthar thug theg gsum rgyan du ma bshad mod/ /theg gcig theg gsum rigs chad yod med dang*/ /mtshan nyid gsum dang bden gnyis 'dod mi 'dod/ de dag sems tsam dbu ma'i khyad par min/ /grub mtha' bzhi kas bden gnyis rnam gzhag byas/ /mtshan nyid gsum po sher phyin las kyang bstan/ /'phags pas byang chub sems 'grel du yang gsungs/ /gnas skabs rigs chad kyang ni mdo der bshad/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can gsungs phyir/ /mthar thug rigs chad mdo sde rgyan na'ang bkag /mthar thug phyir na theg gcig nyid ces gsungs/ /gnas skabs theg gsum rang stong smra ba'ang 'dod/ /byams zhus le 'ur yang ni de mthun gsungs/ /kun rdzob sems tsam rang stong smra ba 'ga'/ / 'dod phyir blun po'i rnam dbyes ci zhig bya/ /rgyal bas sems tsam las 'das ma 'das dang*/ /'jam dbyangs kyis gsungs 'jam dpal zhal lung dang*/ de bzhin 'phags pa lha dang dze tā ri/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel du/ gsungs pa rnams ni rnam gzhag gcig tu 'bab/ /gzung 'dzin snang ba can gyi rnam shes de/ /ngo bo gzung 'dzin las grol bden grub dang*/ / don dam dang ni de bzhin nyid 'dod cing*/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa bden grub ste/ /de la snang ba'i gzung 'dzin bden med lo/ /'di dag sems tsam pa yi grub mthar bshad/ /don la sems tsam du grub dngos po rnams/ /'dod na sems tsam pa yin gzhan ci zhig /dngos rnams log snang sems su'ang bden med pas/ /sems tsam las ni ci yi phyir ma 'das/ /rnam shes rnam pa bden med rtogs pa na/ /kun rdzob snang ba med phyir dbu mar gsungs/

/don dam snang ba yod phyir de min na/ /'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes de dag kyang*/ /dbu ma rtogs pa'i ye shes min par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni dbu sems kyi dbye ba las brtsams te/ gzhan stong dbu mar bsgrubs pa'o// // rang stong smra rnams 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi/ /lung tsam khas len par ni mthun mod kyang*/ /kha cig phyi don 'dod la kha cig 'gog kha cig rang rig 'dod la kha cig 'gog /'ga' zhig rnam shes brgyad 'dod la la 'gog / theg dman pas kyang bdag med gnyis rtogs dang*/ /ma rtogs la sogs rtsa ba'i grub mtha' kun/ /rang bzo'i dbang gis tha dad rnam par 'khrugs/ /chos kun bden med tsam du mthun mod kyang*/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed 'di yi rjes 'brang zhes/ /blo gtad med par rang blo'i lam du 'dren/ /rang stong smra la rang rkang tshugs pa yi/ /theg chen mngon pa dang ni 'dul ba dang*/ /mdo sde'i dgos 'grel rgyas pa med pa'i phyir/ /lta ba kho na logs su dpyad byas nas/ /sde snod gsum gyi gzhung lugs 'chad pa'i tshe/ /la la bye smra kha cig mdo sde ba/ kha cig rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung lugs len/ /gzhan stong smra rnams byams pa'i chos lnga dang*/ /thogs med mched kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtshor 'jug /de phyir rtsa ba'i grub mtha' mi mthun med/ /theg chen sde snod 'grel pa'i gzhung kun la/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung gzhan drang mi 'jog pas/ /ri bor ma rabs brgya phrag du mas kyang*/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal zil gyis mi non bzhin/ /rang stong gzhung gis 'di dag zil mi non/ /kha cig mdo sde gdul bya sna tshogs la/ /dgongs pas gsungs phyir bstan 'chos dbang btsan lo/ /gong du bkag mod gal te bden srid na'ang*/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs 'grel byams pa las lhag pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun btsal kyang med/ /'phags pa klu sgrub tshad mar sgrub pa'i phyir/ /zla bas lang kar gshegs mdo'i lung bstan drangs/

/dkar po rnam par 'char ba'i ṭī ka ru/ /rigs tshogs gzhan stong tshul du bkral zhes grags/ /ga las 'jigs med sogs kyang mthun shas che/ /bzhi brgya pa ni gnas brtan chos skyong gis/ /rnam rig dbu mar bkral zhes zla grags gsungs/ /de phyir 'phags pa yab sras gzhung 'di dag /rang stong ston par cung zad nye mod kyang*/ /'di dag bsgrub bya yin gyi sgrub byed min/ /zla grags phyogs kyi glang po'i phyis byung zhing*/ /'phags pa'i dngos slob rnams la grub mtha' ni/ /tha dad 'byung don med pas thal rang gi /rtsod pa phyis byung yin phyir dpang po min/ khyad par bstod tshogs rnams dang rim lnga dang*/ /byang chub sems 'grel sogs su gzhan stong bstan/ /de phyir klu sgrub dgongs pa gnyis kas len/ /klu sgrub thogs med grub mtha' mtshungs so zhes/ /rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas gsal bar bshad/ /zhi 'tsho sogs kyang 'di dang phyogs mthun gsungs/ /'ga' zhig rang rig 'gog pa ltar na ni/ /so so rang rig theg pa gsal ba dang*/ /rang stong phal cher thal rang rtsod pas 'jug /rtog ge'i spyod yul min zhes 'di mi 'thad/ /chos lnga rang bzhin gsum sogs mi bzhed na/ /bla med theg chen 'chad ces mi rung bas/ /lung bstan ltar na'ang gzhan stong bzhed par 'thad/ /gal te rang stong kho na bzhed srid kyang*/ /mi pham mgon pos gzhan du bkral ba'i phyir/ /dgongs 'grel mkhan po lugs 'di lhag pa yin/ /klu sgrub nyid kyi yi dam yin phyir dang*/ /theg chen pa kun rgyal bar 'dod phyir dang*/ /gsang sngags rgyud las dkyil 'khor gtso bor bstan/ /mdo sde phal cher du yang bstan pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nye ba'i sras gyur dang*/ /tshul ston la yang sa bcu'i dbang phyug yin/ /nyan thos rnams kyang rgyal tshab yin par 'dod/ /klu sgrub mir gyur sa ni dang po brnyes/ /rgyal ba'i drung na mi yi skye bor bstan/ khungs kyang ma 'ongs lung bstan tsam yin zhing*/

/nyan thos pa rnams rtog ge 'chal ba zer/ /dgongs 'grel mkhan po bzang ngan legs dpyod cig /gsang sngags la brten sangs rgyas brnyes srid mod/ /dam pa'i don du mi pham mgon po yang*/ /bskal pa tshad med sngon nas mngon byang chub/ kha cig byams pas gzhan stong bshad mod kyi/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rang stong gsungs so lo/ /'jam dbyangs kyis mdzad de gzhung gang na yod/ /rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam ston pa yi/ /zhal lung dang ni 'jam dpal grags pa yi/ /lta 'dod mdor bstan las ni gzhan stong gsal/ / gzhan ni da lta ma dmigs rdzun gyis ci/ /rang gi lugs la khungs gsal med bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi gzhung mchog rnams la bskur 'debs pa/ /phyogs 'dzin gdon gyis bslad pa ma yin nam/ /'ga' zhig byams chos rang stong yin zer ba/ /rang gi 'khor nang dbang che'i tshig tu zad/ /rgya bod phal cher de mi 'dod pas bla/ /bod rnams thog tha rang stong yin zer ba/ /gzhung gcig nyid la grub mtha' gnyis yod skyon/ khyad par rang rang gzhung dang dngos su 'gal/ / thogs med rgyal bas drang nges 'byed pa yi/ /dgongs 'grel mchog tu lung bstan gsal bar bzhugs/ /gzhan yang dbyig gnyen phyogs kyi glang po dang*/ /chos grags rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba sogs/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis mchog tu lung bstan la/ /ye shes snying po dang ni sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan zla grags 'phags seng la sogs pa/ /mdo rgyud gang nas lung bstan bshad par mdzod/ /dbyig gnyen sogs la ye shes snying po yis/ /shing rta cher bsgrags dpal ldan zla bas kyang*/ /mang du thos shing mkhas par dag pa sbyin/ /mir skyes dgongs 'grel mkhan po dgos na ni/ /rgyal bas lung bstan de rnams gzhan stong smra/ /gzhan de rnams kyang dam pa mchog yin mod/ /lung bstan brnyes pa rnams dang 'gran mi nus/ /dper na zla bas lang kar gshegs mdo la/ /brten nas sems tsam dgongs pa can du bshad/

/dbyig gnyen gyis ni dgongs pa nges 'grel la/ /brten nas ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /dgongs nas ngo bo nyid med bstan ces bkral/ /mdo yi lung dang rigs pa mtshungs mnyam la/ /mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi lung rigs btsan/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug dang mtshungs mkhas pa gzhan/ /'phags pa'i yul du bstan 'chos byed po su/ /rang stong gzhung lugs tshad ma mchog yin dang*/ /khyad par thal 'gyur smra ba mchog yin kyang*/ /sa bon thams cad pa yi kun gzhi ni/ /bkag mod kun gzhi'i ngo bo bkag pa med/ /rig bya rig byed gsal bya gsal byed dang*/ /dran myong nus pa rang rig la bltos pa/ /bkag gis rang rig tsam zhig bkag pa med/ /gzhan dbang bden grub bkag mod yongs grub min/ /rang sems rang bzhin 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad/ /'di 'dra dbu ma'i gzhung las bkag pa med/ khyad par kun gzhi ye shes ma bshad pas/ /yod med gang yang der lung ma bstan no/ /mtshan dpe can gyi snying po drang don du/ /'dod kyi bde gshegs snying po tsam ma bkag/ ces pa ni srol 'byed dang*/ gzhung lugs dang*/ grub mtha'i khung che chung dang*/ phyis kyi bod rnams la dpyad pa ste/ de dag ni lung gi sgrub pa las 'phros pa go bde bar brjod pa'o// //yang 'ga' zhig gzhan stong gi lugs ni mu stegs grangs can dang mtshungs pa'i phyir lta ba 'khrul pa'o zhes zer ro/ /sems tsam yin na mu stegs lugs su 'gal/ /mngon pa mdzod sogs legs bshad chen por rlom/ /then chen gzhung lugs mu stegs dang mtshungs 'dod/ /phrag dog gdon gyis zin pa'i smyon gtam yin/ /kun mtshungs na ni mu stegs lugs yin phyir/ /grub mtha' bzhi yi rnam gzhag med par 'gyur/ /phyogs re 'dra bas de der 'gyur na ni/ /nyan thos sde gnyis bye brag pa dang mtshungs/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa grangs can dang mtshungs mod/ /gcer bu spyod pa'ang dge slong rnams dang mtshungs/

/ snying rje sgom pa'ang mu stegs lugs su 'gyur/ gsang sngags spyod pa dbang phyug pa dang mtshungs/ /khyab 'jug gi zhig lnga pa las kyang*/ ming tsam las ni rab 'das shing*/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /dbyung dang bsdu las nges grol ba/ /de ni nor lha'i bu zhes bya/ /dngos la dngos nyid yod ma yin/ /dngos med la'ang dngos nyid med/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam grol bar/ /gang gis shes de de nyid rig /ces pa dang*/ dbang phyug gi mdzes pa sbyar ba las kyang*/ bu gcig tshangs pa mchog tu bden/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug mu mtha' yas/ /'ba' zhig yod pa nyid smra ba/ /de yang zhags par rab tu brjod/ /ces 'byung bas/ 'di dag dang rang stong smra ba yang cung zad gcig ma gtogs pa lta ba ches mthun no/ /de'i phyir bye brag med do/ /mu stegs kyi lung 'di ni dbu ma rgyan gyi rang 'grel du drangs so/ /kho bos lha khyab 'jug gi mtshan stong dang*/ snying po'i glu che chung dang*/ legs ldan gyi glu dang srid sgrub kyi glu dang*/ dbang phyug gi sam ba da zhes pa dang*/ grangs can pa'i gzhung ci rigs pa bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' :la

(《dzaṃ》 las ) thos mod kyi/ grangs can rnam rdzun gnyis po phyogs mthun las/ /brda chad tsam yang phal cher mi mthun no/ /brda chad 'ga' zhig sngags gzhung rnams dang mthun/ /khyab 'jug gzhung ni thal 'gyur pa dang mthun/ /dbang phyug pa yang rang rgyud pa bzhin sgrogs/ /byed por smra ba de de'i khyad chos yin/ /gnyis na phyogs mtshungs tsam zhig mnyam po la/ /mu stegs grub mtha'i mchog gyur grangs can du/ /grags phyir sangs rgyas pa'i yang 'di mchog go /'ga' zhig yod smras 'ching bar 'dod pa dang*/ /yongs grub yod smras 'ching bar 'dod pa gnyis/ /rgya bod ma gtogs khyad par ci 'dug ltos/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i lung dang bstun na ni/ /gzhan stong 'thad kyi rang stong de ltar min/ kha cig lung la nges pa med pa'i phyir/ /da lta rigs pas grub pa dgos so lo/ /lung rigs gnyis ka med pa'i rang lugs 'jog /rigs pas grub pa shin tu dgos mod kyi/ /zab mo'i gnas lugs tshad ma'i lung gis sgrubs/ /grangs med gsum sgom mthong ba'i lung rdzun na/ /so skye mno bsam ci phyir tshad ma yin// gzhan yang shin tu lkog gyur la lung tshad ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bsam dgos so/ zhes pa ni gzhan stong mu stegs dang 'dra ba'i rtsod pa spangs pa'o// // gcig dang du mar ma grub rnam dpyad pa/ /'di dag 'dus byas chos la 'jug 'gyur gyi/ /'dus ma byas chos gcig min du ma min/ /nam mkha' la sogs dbye ba des mi 'jug /'on kyang 'khrul blos brtags pa tsam nyid las/ /ngo bo ci yang med phyir de med yin/ /khyod lugs chos nyid med par dgag pa'i phyir/ /ci yang med phyir de la 'gyur ba med/ /phyogs dang dus kyi cha shas rnam dbye ba/ /yod na de la mi 'gyur mi srid de/ /phyogs yod dbang shes yul min med pa dang*/ /dus ni 'das sogs dus gsum phyir 'gyur bcas/ /skye sogs bkag pas chos dbyings 'di mi khegs/

/ye shes 'di yang skye med 'gag med yin/ /'phags pa'i dbu ma'i gzhung lugs che chung du/ /rgyu rkyen dang ni 'gro 'ong mtshan mtshon dang*/ /sngon dang phyi mtha' rgyu 'bras rten 'brel sogs/ /rigs pa'i dpyad pa mtha' yas de kun yang*/ /kun rdzob kho na la 'jug gzhan la min/ /rgyu sogs de dag kun rdzob kho na'i phyir/ /chos nyid du 'gyur chos can la mi ltos/ /tha snyad chos can la ltos rang ngos med/ /chos nyid rang ngos rnam par gzhag 'jog gi /rgyu 'bras ltos grub med phyir rten 'brel min/ /zhes pa ni rang stong gi rigs pa las grol bar bstan pa'o// //chos kun stong pa gzhan stong lugs nyid yin/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid med gzhan stong lugs/ /rang stong smra la gsal cha dang snang cha/ /stong bar mi 'dod phyir na tshig tsam len/ /bum sogs snang ba stong pa nyid yin na/ khyed kyi lugs la don dam bden par 'gyur/ /stong nyid min na chos kun stong par 'gal/ / gzhan stong pa rnams stong nyid rnam gsum dang*/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam pa gsum 'dod cing*/ /de de don dam kho nar mi 'dod pas/ /nang 'gal med cing grub mtha' khyad 'phags byung*/ /kun rdzob kyi ni stong cha don dam min/ /don dam gyi yang snang cha kun rdzob min/ /zhes pa ni chos kun stong nyid rang stong kho na dang 'gal bar bstan pa'o// //rang stong sems tsam las ni 'das pa'i phyir/ /dbu ma yin mod dbu ma'i mthar thug min/ /stong nyid tsam yin stong nyid mthar thug min/ /nges don yin yang nges don mthar thug min/ /rgyu mtshan rang stong smra rnams dbu ma yang*/ /mthar thug khas mi len phyir dbu ma ci/ /rang stong gzhung la dpyad tshe dbu ma med/ /gzhan stong pa ni dpyad kyang dbu mar 'dod/ /rang 'dod mthar thug dbu ma mi 'dod pa'i/ /dbu ma chen po de 'dra mtshar gyi med/ /de yang yod na sems tsam mi 'dod pa'i/ /sems tsam pa dang theg dman mdo sde'i

tshogs/ /mi 'dod mdo sde pa dang bye smra yang*/ /bye brag bshad pa mi len yod dam ci/ /kun tu rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa ma yin nam/ /rang stong lugs la stong nyid yod mi srid/ /don dam du ni med phyir mthar thug min/ /med dgag tsam la mthar thug ma thug dang*/ /dbyings dang dbyings min la sogs med pa'i phyir/ /don dam dbyings zhes bya ba'ang srid min 'gyur/ /yang na stong nyid dang ni don dam dbyings/ /kun rdzob nyid du ci yi phyir mi 'gyur/ /rtog ngo'i yul dang mthong ba rdzun pa'i yul/ /dpyad ngor med dang bden med kun rdzob tu/ /'jog byed min na kun rdzob gang gis 'jog /yin na don dam dbyings ni bden par 'gyur/ /kun rdzob min pas bden yod dpyad ngor yod/ /yongs grub 'dod phyir dbu ma min na ni/ /spros bral 'dod pa'ang dbu ma min par 'gyur/ /bden 'dod mi 'dod khyad par yod ce na/ /mtshan ma spros pa'i bden par nged mi 'dod/ /spros pas dben pa'i bden tshul 'di lta bu/ /rang stong smra bas phyogs kyang ma go na/ /de la dgag pa nam yang byas pa med/ /bden grub 'gog tshad spros pa'i bden 'gog ste/ /kun rdzob 'gog pa'i rigs pa 'dir sbyar phyir/ /de ni nged kyi lugs la'ang 'dod pa ste/ /yongs grub de la spros pa'i bden pa med/ /spros pa'i bden pa yod na kun rdzob ste/ /don dam ngo bo nyid med ces bshad do/ /nyan thos pa rnams theg gsum spangs pa gcig /ces 'dod thal 'gyur ba yang de rjes 'brang*/ /rgyu mtshan bdag med gnyis rtogs mtshungs phyir ro/ /'di la ngo bo nyid sku nyan rang la/ /yod par thal ba bzlog med 'jug par 'gyur/ /ngo bo nyid sku dang mtshungs de min pa/ /srid na sku gsum gzhan la'ang rigs pa mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas dang mnyam sangs rgyas min pa sogs/ /ha cang thal ba mang po 'jug par 'gyur/ /'di yang theg dman grub mtha' 'dres pa'i skyon/

/shes sgrib kyi ni spangs pas khyad ce na/ / 'di yang spangs pa'i khyad par nyid bstan gyis/ /ngo bo dbye ba med phyir zlog mi nus/ /ston pa thams cad smon lam dbang gis yin/ /ye shes snang med 'dod pas lhag med dang*/ /khyad par med phyir chos skur mtshungs par 'gyur/ /dman pas chos kun bdag med gnyis rtogs na/ /chos sku mthong phyir de ni theg dman gyi/ /'phags pa rnams dang thun mong 'bras bur 'gyur/ /bum la ka ba med tsam ka ba la/ /bum med tsam ni dbye ba yod min pas/ /med dgag tsam gyi spangs pa kun gcig 'gyur/ /kun gzhi med phyir sa bon 'jog gnas med/ /sems dang sems byung bem po'i chos 'gags phyir/ /theg gsum lhag med ci phyir mtshungs mi 'gyur/ /med dgag tsam la shes bya'-i sgrib pa'ang ci/ / lung gsal med cing gzhan la lung gsal yod/ /de phyir theg dman 'phags pas chos thams cad/ /chos bdag med par rtogs zhes 'di mi 'thad/ /rdzas dang brtags yod kun rtog rgyas pa ste/ /de ma rtogs na chos kun rtogs par 'gal/ /gsal min zhe na mngon sum la mi 'thad/ /rgyu mtshan ma shes phyir na de ma rtogs/ /rtogs pa khyad zhugs tsam gyis dbyer mi nus/ /phyi don 'dod dang rnam shes drug nges dang*/ /kun gzhi 'gog dang rang rig 'gog pa dang*/ /nyan rang skyabs kyi yul du 'dod pa sogs/ /rang stong pa la theg dman grub mtha' 'dres// zhes pa ni rang stong dbu ma mthar thug tu 'dod pa dgag pa'o// //gal te rang stong lugs kyi spros bral de/ /med dgag phyir na sus kyang myong mi srid/ /dngos med myong ba gang du'ang yod ma yin/ /rtog pas don spyi yul du byed pa yi/ /sel ngo tsam la rtogs par 'dogs na thogs/ /de 'dra 'khrul ba yin phyir don mi rtogs/ /spros bral de 'dra bden na bden grub ste/ /min na kun rdzob rnams dang bden med mnyam/ /rgyal sogs ye shes mchog la spros bral de/

/snang na de ngor yaud phyir de bden 'gyur/ /mi snang na ni kun rdzob don dam gnyis/ /'phags pa'i gzigs ngor med pa mnyam por 'gyur/ /ye shes ma 'khrul bayis med gzigs phyir/ /spros bral 'khrul 'gyur des na 'khrul bar mnyam/ /de ni kun rdzob don dam dbye mi nus/ /kun tu mtshungs shing gnyis na don dam las/ /kun rdzob dngos la zhugs shing bzang bar 'gyur/ /yang dag don du med mnyam kun rdzob ni/ /'khrul ngor don byed don dam de yang min/ /da ni khyed cag kun rdzob tshad mas grub/ /don dam med nges yin zhes 'dod la rag /ngo tsha'i lta ba 'di 'dra smad par 'os/ /'jig rten ma brtags ngor ni dngos kun yod/ /dpyad ngor med ces bya ba 'di dpyad bya/ /kun rdzob don dam du med kun rdzob tu/ /yod ces bya ba 'di ni dpyad ngo ste/ /'jig rten kun rdzob don dam dbye ba med/ khyed lugs ltar na kun rdzob don dam yod/ /de gnyis bden gnyis gang du'ang med 'dod dgos/ /snang ba kun rdzob de yis stong pa ni/ /don dam yin la kun rdzob snang mi 'gags/ / nges ngor bden 'dzin spangs phyir mtha' gnyis spangs/ /zhe na don dam snang ba khyod mi 'dod/ /mnyam bzhag ngor ni snang ba de med phyir/ /med mthar 'gyur bas de phyir dbu ma min/ /bden gnyis kun rdzob don dam skabs kun tu/ /yod mnyam med mnyam mtshungs pa yin zhes zer/ /don dam du yod mi srid kun rdzob tu/ /thams cad yod ces bya ba 'di nyid 'gal/ /don dam kun rdzob tu ni yod pa'i phyir/ /kun rdzob kyang der yod 'gyur kun mtshungs phyir/ /don dam kun rdzob tu ni yod gyur na/ /don dam kun rdzob yin par thal 'gyur te/ /mi ru yod pa'i 'gro ba mi yin bzhin/ /gzhan yang don dam don dam par grub dgos/ /min na grub phyir kun rdzob tu grub 'gyur/ /yang na don dam gzhi ma grub par thal/ /de phyir don dam dam pa'i don du grub/

/don dam 'khrul ngor snang bas der yod na/ /don dam rtogs pa'i shes pa 'khrul ba dang*/ /'khrul bas stong nyid rtogs par thal bar 'gyur/ /phyis kyi dbu ma'i 'dod pa 'di ltar na/ /kun rdzob yod phyir ye shes 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /mnyam gzhag 'khrul na rjes thob lta ci smos/ /ye shes de ngor kun rdzob snang na ni/ /kun rdzob bden 'gyur gal te snang na yang*/ /bden snang med zer kun rdzob med snang ba/ /kun rdzob snang ba min zhing kun rdzob yod/ /ye shes la ni med par snang phyir 'khrul/ /de ngor yod snang na ni de bden 'gyur/ /rgyu mtshan phyin ci ma log yul yin phyir/ /bkag pa 'gog pa sgrub par 'dod pa yi/ / rang stong pa la 'di skad brjod par bya/ /chos nyid bden med de ni gal te bden/ /gzhan stong smra ba rnams dang cis mi mtshungs/ /de mi bden na dgag pa'i tshig gnyis kyis/ /rnal mar go phyir bden yod kho nar 'gyur/ /don dam du med dpyad ngor med sogs mtshungs/ /zhes pa ni rang stong smra ba 'ga' zhig gis grub mtha' dpyad cing*/ de nyid kyi rigs pas gzhan stong du bsgrubs pa'o// //chos nyid 'gyur ba med phyir chos kyi sku/ /sem can rnams la nges par yod par 'gyur/ /dang por chos sku min pa phyis der 'gyur/ /de ni ngo bo 'gyur bcas kho na yin/ /'dus byas nam yang mi gnas de phyir med/ /de bzhin nyid 'di nges par 'dus ma byas/ /dngos po dngos med las 'das shes pa yin/ /'gog byed med dang ma 'khrul ye shes kyi/ /gzigs ngo yin phyir 'khrul yang ma 'khrul bas/ /don dam dbyings ni bden par grub pa yin/ /kun rdzob kyi ni shes pa bslu ba'i chos/ /bems po dang ni dngos med myong bya min/ /de phyir dbyings de shes pa don dam yin/ /dbyings kyi de bzhin nyid de dge ba ste/ / don dam dge ba yin phyir dge ba'i mchog /kun rdzob dge ba dge ba nyid yin na/

/don dam dge ba ci phyir dge ba min/ de skad du rgyan stug po'i mdo las kyang*/ sa rnams sna tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /bde gshegs snying po dge ba'ang de/ /kun gzhi de la snying po'i sgras/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs la/ chos mngon pa las/ don dam pa'i dge ba gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid do/ /zhes bshad do/ /'dis ni kun gzhi ye shes bstan pa ste/ / de bzhin nyid phyir ye shes kho na dang*/ /dge bar bshad pas kun gzhi rnam shes min/ /kun gzhi dang ni bde gshegs snying por bstan/ /mngon par de bzhin nyid de byang chub kyi/ /rgyur gsungs 'dus ma byas su'ang bshad pa'i phyir/ /don dam 'gog pa'i bden pa bden gcig pu/ /dngos med min zhing kun rdzob las 'das pa'o/ /gzhan stong 'di ni gcig gis cig shos stong*/ /de phyir stong nyid tha shal yin snyam na/ /mdo las stong nyid rnam pa bdun du gsungs/ /mtshan nyid stong dang dngos po'i rang bzhin stong*/ /srid pa'i stong nyid mi srid stong nyid dang*/ /brjod du med pa'i stong nyid zhes pa dang*/ /'phags pa'i ye shes don dam stong chen dang*/ /gcig gis gcig stong stong pa bdun pa'o/ /dngos rnams rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis stong dang*/ /dngos rnams rang bzhin skye bas stong pa dang*/ /phung po bdag gis stong dang phung po sogs/ /myang 'das kyis stong kun brtags ngo bos stong*/ /don dam ye shes lta nyes bag chags kyis/ /stong dang dngos po so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gcig gcig stong pa rnams la rim bzhin bshad/ /drug pa mchog ste bdun pa tha ma yin/ /gang zag bdag med rtag tu gzhan stong ste/ /'on kyang tha shal stong nyid min pa bzhin/ /de bzhin nyid dang chos sku lam bden gsum/ /don dam zhes bshad 'gyur med yongs grub ni/ /'dus ma byas dang don dam bden pa yin/ /sher phyin lnga brgya par yang stong nyid gsum/ /mtshan nyid gsum yang gsungs phyir yid ches bya/

/zhes pa ni rang lugs kyi 'thad pa cung zad nye bar bstan pa'o// //'dir ni gzhan stong spyi la rgol ba dag /lung rigs dang bcas drang pos rnam par dpyad/ /gzhan du zhib mor dpyad pa ji snyed dang*/ /rang lugs rnams ni gzhung du shes par bya/ /gcig dang du bral rigs pa'i rtsa ba yang*/ / 'dus byas gnas pa med pa la thug pas/ /de dang bdag 'gog ci rigs rgyan na gsal/ /nyi shu pa ru phyi don 'gog pa bstan/ /rang lugs dbus mtha' rnam 'byed gtsor gyur pa'i/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung kun na gsal bar bzhugs/ /rigs pa rgyas pa bstan 'chos rgyas par gsal/ /'di kun dbu ma'i gzhung lugs zla med pa'o/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis yang yang bshad mod kyang*/ /gzhung lugs chen po'i nang du 'thor bas na/ /nyer mkho go bar sla ba 'ga' zhig bshad/ /rigs pa gsar ba du ma'ang rnam par spel/ /theg pa che tshul thun mong min pa 'di/ /sems tsam yin 'dod grags ngan spang phyir dang*/ /khyad par lung tsam skyabs gyur yin zer ba/ /de dag 'joms pa'i rigs pa 'di nyid sbyar/ /da dung dpyad pa phra mo grangs med pa/ /spro bar nus mod 'gro bas rtogs dkar 'gyur/ /gal te gzhan la phan thogs nus med na/ /dgos pa dang bral de phyir 'dir ma bris/ /'di bshad dge bas mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /theg mchog dam pa'i chos 'dir yongs zhugs te/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob cing*/ /zag med chos kyi dga' ba la spyod shog/ ces pa gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan zhes pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bkod pa ste/ rang lo sum cu pa la jo nang gi ri khrod du'o// //dge legs 'phel/ tshigs bcad gsar pa brgya nga bdun yod do/ /maṅga laṃ/ zhus dag /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 122 -- PAGE 123 -- PAGE 102 -
